Name: Dungeon Delver Arcade Expansion
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#FFB300]DUNGEON DELVER[/color][/b][/size]
[color=#C8A800]An Arcade Expansion[/color][/center]


[size=4][b][color=#FFB300]OVERVIEW[/color][/b][/size]

Dungeon Delver adds a complete standalone first-person dungeon crawler to Stardew Valley, accessible from an arcade cabinet in the Stardrop Saloon. Descend 65 floors of procedurally generated dungeon levels, battle escalating enemies, collect powerful relics, discover weapon upgrades, and face terrifying bosses.

Gus sends the farmer a letter telling them about the new arcade machine in the saloon. A short event triggers when you walk into the saloon after reading the letter. 

Q: What’s with the generative-ai tag?
A: This involved a lot of code and I’m just one person. I used AI to help check my work only. It does not think for me. 
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b][color=#FFB300]FEATURES[/color][/b][/size]

[b]Three Playable Classes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Warrior[/b] — Balanced melee fighter with a sword and strong defenses. 100 HP.[/*]
[*][b]Berserker[/b] — High-damage axe fighter. Hits hard but slower than the warrior. 120 HP.[/*]
[*][b]Wizard[/b] — Ranged staff user who fires magical bolts. Quick on their feet. 70 HP.[/*]
[/list]
[b]65 Dungeon Floors[/b]
[list]
[*][b]17 layouts[/b] — Crossroads, Maze, Throne Room, Barracks, Spiral, Chasm, Pillared Hall, and more[/*]
[*][b]Fully procedural floors[/b] — randomized room placement, corridors, and enemy spawns on deeper floors[/*]
[*][b]4 dungeon themes[/b] — Old Stone Dungeon, Blood Crypt, Arcane Ruins, Hell Rift[/*]
[*]Every 5th floor is a [b]boss floor[/b], every 10th floor offers a [b]level-up upgrade[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Combat[/b]
[list]
[*]Melee swinging, ranged projectiles, and a Repel burst ability that pushes enemies back[/*]
[*]5 enemy types: Skeleton, Slime, Cultist, Shadow, and Orc[/*]
[*]Enemies scale in HP and speed with floor depth[/*]
[/list]
[b]Boss Fights[/b]
[list]
[*]Regular bosses every 5 floors, each accompanied by Orc guards [/*]
[*]The [b]Eye of Ruin[/b] — a multi-phase final boss with minion spawning, becomes enraged at 50% HP[/*]
[*]Defeating the final boss triggers a [b]letter from Marlon[/b] the next morning with a special surprise[/*]
[/list]
[b]Progression Systems[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Relic system[/b] — collect up to 3 passive relics at a time from drops and shrines (expandable via upgrades), each one offering unique power ups[/*]
[*][b]Level-up system[/b] — choose one of 3 random upgrades: bonus HP, damage boost, speed increase, extra potions, full heal, or extra relic slot[/*]
[*][b]Weapon shrine on floor 31[/b] — find your class's upgraded weapon in a dedicated shrine room[/*]
[*][b]Deathless streak bonus[/b] — clear 5+ floors without dying to earn a bonus Diamond each floor[/*]
[*][b]Progress save system[/b] — Continue your run where you left off, including all relics, upgrades, and stats[/*]
[/list]
[b]Floor Modifiers[/b]
Random modifiers that can appear on deeper floors:
[list]
[*][b]Darkness[/b] — your torch barely reaches the walls[/*]
[*][b]Haste[/b] — all enemies move faster[/*]
[*][b]Weakened[/b] — you deal half damage[/*]
[*][b]Crowded[/b] — extra enemies spawn[/*]
[*][b]Fortified[/b] — enemies have bonus HP[/*]
[/list]
[b]Loot & Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*]Loot picked up in Dungeon Delvers places items of varying value in your inventory. [/*]
[*]Floor-clear rewards scale with depth: early floors yield Quartz and Iron Ore; deep floors reward Prismatic Shards, Iridium Ore, Treasure Chests, and Magic Rock Candy[/*]
[*]Health potions awarded on floor clear, scaling with floor and difficulty[/*]
[*]Coins, potions, and power shards can drop from barrels[/*]
[/list]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[size=4][b][color=#FFB300]CONFIGURATION (GMCM)[/color][/b][/size]

Requires General Mod Config Menu (optional but recommended). 

Difficulty can be adjusted for a more intense or cozy experience. 
[b][u]**Beware - difficulty cannot be changed mid-run. You will need to begin a new run to see the effects of settings change**[/u][/b]
